name: music-skill
description: Write original instrumental music as editable notes: the agent composes and arranges every note, and the skill checks the score, plays it on licensed sampled instruments (pianos, guitars, basses, drums, a full orchestra, saxophones, organ and world instruments), built-in synthesizers or Surge XT presets with player-like timing and dynamics, mixes it through buses and generated reverbs, and masters it with MIDI, stems and an MP3. No audio-generation model is involved.

interface.longDescription:
music-skill writes original instrumental music the way a composer and a small studio would. Your agent writes every note into a project file; the skill checks the score for clashing voices, plays it on sampled instruments from licensed banks (pianos, guitars, basses, drum kits, a full orchestra, saxophones, organ and world instruments) or on built-in synthesizers, drum machines and Surge XT presets, with player-like timing and dynamics, legato and bends, mixes it through drum, bass, rhythm, ensemble and lead buses with generated reverbs, and masters it to a set loudness with a true peak at or below -1 dBTP.

You get an MP3 and a WAV, the MIDI, a stem per part and the project file. Change one note and only that part renders again.

No audio-generation model is involved. It runs locally in Python with NumPy, FluidSynth and FFmpeg, and Surge XT if installed; setup downloads the tools and sound banks from their publishers and checks every file by SHA-256.

Limitations: it does not sing, host plugins other than Surge XT, or judge whether music is good. Its measurements point at problems; a person still has to listen.
defaultPrompt: Write a 90-second instrumental for my game's title screen: warm, a little melancholic, piano and strings.
Make an anime-opening-style track in TV size: a guitar band with a piano melody.
Simplify the chorus melody in bar 33 and render it again with the MIDI and stems.
